newsitem.title: USA: World Bank approves $300 million loan to Brazil.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $300 million loan to Brazil.

text.p: The World Bank on Friday said it had approved a $300 million loan to finance a highway rehabilitation project in Brazil.
The loan, approved on Thursday, is repayable in 15 years, including a five-year grace period, at the bank's standard LIBOR-based rate for single-currency loans.
The World Bank will provide further funding for the project, but has yet to negotiate the terms with Brazil, a spokeswoman said.
Additional financing for the $1.25 billion project will come via $500 million in loans from the Inter-American Development Bank and $250 million from Brazilian authorities, the World Bank said.
